summary.tldr: Amends the Citizenship Act so some people who lost Canadian citizenship can regain it.
what_it_does: Lets back former citizens who applied to keep their citizenship under the old section 8 rules, but whose application was not approved, regain citizenship.
Adds a new path to citizenship for people born outside Canada after February 14, 1977, if they would be citizens had they applied to keep citizenship under the old section 8 rules.
Keeps this change from applying to anyone who was already a citizen on June 11, 2015.
Updates a related Citizenship Act rule so it refers to people who are citizens under the new and existing citizenship paragraphs.
who_it_affects: People born outside Canada after February 14, 1977
People whose citizenship retention application was denied
summary.background: The bill changes the Citizenship Act rules for people who lost citizenship because of the old section 8 retention process. That section is referred to as it read before April 17, 2009.
